About Contoso Health

You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams. The team ships weekly and keeps a short list of priorities that everyone can read.
description.role: You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams. The team ships weekly and keeps a short list of priorities that everyone can read. You will write clear requirements, review designs with engineers and check the result against the goal. Most of the work is turning vague requests into scoped, testable changes.
